influences.name: John Lennon
influences.context: Speaking after the performance, Turner cited listening to John Lennon as a way of calming any nerves. 'We made a playlist to play before [the set]. We just put a load of tunes on it and the last one was 'Imagine' by John Lennon. The crowd was ready for us to go on before that song dropped. We were standing behind the curtain doing what everyone else in the crowd was doing - singing along to Lennon.'
